title: Automation is not a dirty word

questions.question: A clear rule can route an alert correctly every time. What is the most sensible first choice?
options: Use an LLM because it sounds more flexible
Ask a human to route every alert
questions.explanation: Use a deterministic rule when the work is clear and stable. Models add value where language or uncertainty is genuinely part of the task.

questions.question: Which part of an automation lets a human reconstruct why it acted?
questions.explanation: Evidence and an event history make decisions inspectable. They are useful with or without a model.
